memories.memory: When asking for approval of a change, start with the file it changes, then show the exact text before and after.
Avoid sentence shapes that make readers stop and decode, and say the plain version.
Take the most care with the summary at the end of a task.
In text published under the user's name, say only what they have done, and name the work by what it literally is.
Pick the writing style by who will read the text: people or only an AI.
When a shorter wording is harder to read, use the longer one.
When warning people about a risk, show a concrete example of what would actually happen.
When discussing data the user will debug with, show the raw records with their source every time.
Text only an AI reads may be dense, but spell out every term from the session.
Write for a reader who was not in the conversation, and explain terms from the session.
